instruction: Add deterministic cross-process duplicate-creation coverage for the filesystem transaction, then rerun the declared verification contract and record the result against the same implementation behavior.

findings.summary: The duplicate-creation regression test exercises two concurrent runCli calls in one process, so it does not prove the intended cross-process CLI serialization behavior.
